records.subject: You're in -- let's get Union Works set up
records.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for trying Wrenfield. A quick tip: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so the first few minutes are usually spent creating one project and adding a few tasks to it.

Let us know how it goes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone and no tickets; two CSM nudges (email:7f2feef1, email:aba9f0b4) produced only a one-line non-committal reply (email:3c9f5292) with no stated use case or timeline. Starter, single admin. Some chance they self-serve in the remaining 8 days, but engagement signal is weak.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Union Works' setup
draft.body:
Hi Mateo,

Thanks for getting back to me -- glad to hear it. Since you mentioned you'd keep me posted, I wanted to make one thing easy: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and get Union Works' first project set up with you so the structure matches how your team already works.

Either way, just reply here and I'll help with whatever next step is in the way.

Best,
Chidi
